author: Marlon Chaviano
name: saas-sveltekit
title: SaaS with SvelteKit
description: SvelteKit with the official add-ons: Better Auth with email and password, Drizzle with a SQLite/Turso database, Tailwind CSS and Vitest.

base.command: npx sv@latest create {{name}} --template minimal --types ts --add tailwindcss="plugins:none" drizzle="database:sqlite+client:libsql" better-auth="demo:password" vitest="usages:unit" --no-install

instructions:
## How to work here

- Data is loaded in `+page.server.ts` (`load`) and mutations are *form actions*; the Better Auth session is in `event.locals` (see `src/hooks.server.ts`).
- The Drizzle schema is in `src/lib/server/db/schema.ts`; apply changes with `npm run db:push`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
